inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Iron cold against the wrist
The crowd demands a final kiss
Of dust and blood upon the stone
The witness stands alone, alone
My oath was forged in salt and pain
To cut the traitor by the mane
But as I raised the heavy steel
Her eyes revealed the truth I feel

[Chorus]
Oath of the broken blade
Shatter the iron that I made
I will not kill the final light
In the dark of the dying night
Break the sword, let the blood flow
Watch the kingdom’s shadow grow

[Verse]
The snap of oak beneath my heel
The pieces scatter on the field
The King’s cavalry rides hard
Spear and shield in the dark
They roar for heads and spines
For the price of my broken lines
I stand with only jagged steel
And the weight of the oath I feel

[Chorus]
Oath of the broken blade
Shatter the iron that I made
I will not kill the final light
In the dark of the dying night
Break the sword, let the blood flow
Watch the kingdom’s shadow grow

[Bridge]
Now the chargers break the line
Horses scream, the air is mine
I swing the shards, a jagged arc
A thousand spears, a single spark
My ribs crack, the dust is thick
The final witness, I can't stick
I fall upon the broken ground
Where the kingdom’s roots are found

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Oath of the broken blade
Shatter the iron that I made
I will not kill the final light
In the dark of the dying night
Break the sword, let the blood flow
Watch the kingdom’s shadow grow

[Outro]
The blade is dust
The oath is trust
The king is gone
The song is sung
